html:
You are planning to visit Vietnam to enjoy the scenery and experience the diverse culture. So today Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise things to know when traveling to Vietnam. Please refer to the content below.

1. Essential items when traveling Vietnam you should know

Passport

A passport is the first necessary document no matter where you go, when leaving the country you live in you need to bring it, this is a mandatory identification document that must be carried with you, and must be valid for at least 6 months. If you are planning to go abroad and do not have a passport, please contact the Immigration Department (under the local police in the province/city where you reside) to apply, or apply directly online. In case you already have a passport but it is torn, please immediately notify the Immigration Department where you applied for a passport and request a reissue.

Visas

Except for countries that have visa exemption agreements for Vietnamese passport holders, all other countries require tourists to have a visa when entering their country. To apply for a visa, you need to go through the visa application process at the Embassy or Consulate General.

Foreign tourists who are currently abroad and want to enter Vietnam can directly apply for an e-visa to Vietnam or through an inviting organization or individual to be sponsored. The Vietnam e-visa is valid for a single entry and is valid for no more than 30 days.

Visa application procedures vary by country and the level of difficulty in applying for a visa also varies. Some countries that are difficult to apply for a visa include: the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, Japan, Korea and Macau.

Wallets and bank cards

Wallets and bank cards are essential items that you need to prepare and check carefully before traveling anywhere, they are very necessary for you to pay for your travel expenses. You should prepare both cash and money in your ATM account higher than your initial spending plan because there may be unexpected expenses.

If you are traveling abroad, you can go to the bank to exchange money in advance instead of exchanging money at the airport, because the fee will be lower.

Luggage

You should learn about the places you are going to, check the weather to match the beautiful clothes, and what to carry and what to check in before going on a tour of Vietnam.

Carry-on luggage: According to the regulations of airlines, Business class passengers are allowed to carry 02 pieces of carry-on luggage, while Economy class passengers are allowed to carry 01 piece of carry-on luggage, each piece weighing no more than 7kg and measuring no more than 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 × 14 × 9 inches).

Checked baggage: Depending on the airline, service class and flight route, there will be different regulations on checked baggage. Normally, low-cost airlines will charge for checked baggage, while other airlines will exempt a certain weight of checked baggage.

Travel Guides and Maps

Whether you are booking a Vietnam tour or traveling independently, travel guidebooks and maps are always necessary. Guidebooks can be purchased at bookstores, and maps can be purchased at the airport.

2. Basic notes when preparing to travel to Vietnam

Choose the best travel agency in Vietnam. If this is your first time in Vietnam, you should consider reputable travel agencies, which is important when you do not know reputable travel agencies for the first time. Therefore, you should pay attention to the following priorities:

The address of the travel agency must be public, the website must be deleted, the phone number must be public and not blocked from strangers, the tour content must be transparent even outside of business hours, departure time, tour price, conditions for complete cancellation, children’s prices, airfare, airport pick-up time… must be displayed publicly and displayed on the website or group tours in Vietnam.

Age of operation: Before registering for the best Vietnam tour, visitors should also learn about the history of the company’s formation and development. Of course, reputable travel agencies will exist for a long time, because tourism is not a new industry, and tourism has been discovered for a long time and is developing very strongly.

Professional working style: An honest and legitimate travel agency will certainly train a team of professional staff. Through the way of working and guiding Vietnamese tourism when customers book a tour, customers can evaluate which company is of high quality or a scam tool.

Choose a Vietnam tour service that suits your needs and interests

There are often some travel companies that are willing to sell Vietnam tour services at very cheap prices, or 0 VND tours, however, these tours will not guarantee quality, and they will also introduce you to famous tourist attractions with high fees. Therefore, you should consider and choose for yourself suitable and affordable tours so that you can visit happily and not incur any additional costs when you have registered for a package tour.

Therefore, if you want to go on a quality tour, the amount of money you spend must correspond to the value of the tour, you should not choose tours that are too cheap, poor quality will affect your trip. Therefore, you should consider carefully before going on a tour to Vietnam or anywhere else.

Learn about Vietnamese culture and laws before you arrive.

Cultural and legal differences are one of the common reasons for misunderstandings between locals and tourists. In some cases, locals may even feel offended.

When you come to Vietnam, a country with friendly and hospitable people and an open culture to the world, preparing some knowledge about the culture in advance will make your visit to Vietnam more convenient and meaningful than ever.

Buy travel insurance

After preparing all the necessary items in your suitcase, don’t forget an essential item for every trip: international travel insurance. Many people ignore this important factor, feeling that it is unnecessary. However, when something unexpected happens, they may regret not having enough budget or language skills to handle it.

In some cases, overseas travel insurance is mandatory when applying for a visa to enter another country, such as Australia. If you have never purchased this product before, you can refer to and choose to buy insurance for your own safety.

3. Top 10 tourist destinations in Vietnam you should visit at least once in your life.

Sapa

A destination chosen by many tourists, a year-round tourist destination, Sapa will bring visitors a unique beauty each season, spring weather with flowers competing to show off their bright colors such as cherry blossoms, apricot blossoms, plum blossoms… In the summer, Sapa welcomes visitors with the pouring water season, in the fall with golden rice fields, in the winter Sapa is immersed in pure white snow…

In addition, when coming to Sapa, visitors can experience campfires, visit villages or freely take virtual photos at luxury resorts, and enjoy delicious and attractive dishes and experience the life of the people in the Northwest highlands.

Hue

A place with a solemn and ancient beauty, a gentle beauty expressed through traditional ao dai, conical hats and the graceful beauty of Hue girls, with elegant culture and poetic scenery? Hue has left visitors with the most beautiful impressions during the tour. If you come to Hue, remember to visit the citadel to admire and learn about the historical significance of this place.

Hue Citadel is the home of many kings throughout history, and you will discover many interesting things, especially the excellent Hue cuisine, especially for those who love spicy food.

Phan Thiet

When talking about Phan Thiet, people immediately know that there are clear blue beaches and luxurious resorts that will bring visitors the most interesting experiences.

Phu Quoc

A destination chosen by many tourists, you can go to Phu Quoc at any time of the year. If you have the opportunity to travel to Phu Quoc, visit destinations such as Bai Dai, Bai Sao, VinWonders Phu Quoc, Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc, Grand World…

It can be said that Phu Quoc still retains its pristine beauty with turquoise beaches, long stretches of white sand, and rows of coconut trees swaying in the wind. This is an ideal resort destination for tourists who love to admire the beauty of nature and admire the beauty of the sea and islands.

Nha Trang

A 4-season stopover, a place to welcome visitors with poetic beaches, visitors should visit the 4-island tour and scenic areas of Hon Tre, Hon Tam, Hon Mun, Hon Mot or famous destinations such as: VinWonders Nha Trang, Hon Mun Island, Ponagar Tower…

In addition, visitors can also visit the beautiful beaches or experience walking on Diep Son beach with clear blue water, admire the panoramic view, and enjoy fresh seafood, especially lobster of Binh Ba island… and many more famous specialties waiting for visitors to discover.

Da Nang – Hoi An

Famous tourist destination in the Central region, with famous landmarks, exciting sea games, and a 5-star resort located majestically on the sea will bring visitors the most interesting experiences.

Hoi An Ancient Town, visitors will immerse themselves in the space of the Old Town with lantern lights, or stroll along the Thu Bon River, ancient houses hundreds of years old, or check-in areas chosen by many tourists.

Ha Long Bay

As one of the famous tourist destinations in Northern Vietnam, with thousands of large and small islands, the natural landscape always captivates people. In addition, this is also a place where you can enjoy fresh seafood. For tourists looking for a tour near Hanoi, Ha Long Bay is the destination for you.

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Vietnam, you should choose to visit Ha Long Bay, you will be able to see with your own eyes the most interesting things that nature has bestowed upon this place, and enjoy delicious and attractive dishes or experience on a 5-star Ha Long cruise will bring visitors the most unforgettable experience.

Da Lat

Da Lat is a dreamy city that makes any visitor who sets foot in Da Lat admire, with the sound of pine trees chirping, flowers blooming in competition, or green vegetable fields, besides, if you want to experience a peaceful feeling, experience cycling to admire the beauty of the city.

Ca Mau

A place with beautiful natural scenery, with gentle and hospitable people, when traveling to the West of Ca Mau, visitors can take a boat to admire the beauty of the river or visit the floating markets with goods displayed right on the boats, a bustling market between buyers and sellers of the typical culture of the river region.

Ca Mau with its lush green forests and sparkling sea like a paradise on earth. For a complete travel experience, let’s travel with Vietlook to explore the beauty of Ca Mau today.
